sn35.94:4.1: This series of verses resembles those attributed to Vardhamāna (Mahāvīra) at Isibhāsiyāiṁ 29. The same series of verses also contains parallels to [snp5.2:3.1](), [sn1.6:3.1](), and [dn2:29.4]() = [mn56:12.2]().
sn35.94:8.3: The mention of “duality” links this to the preceding two discourses.
sn35.94:9.2: “Attraction” (_upāya_, verb form _upeti_, here spelled _upayanti_) is the initial stage in the process of becoming attached (eg. [sn12.15:2.5]()).
sn35.94:9.3: This unusual use of _manomayaṁ_ (normally “mind-made”, here “mental construction”) parallels _vitakkaṁ_ at [thag21.1:6.2]().
